name: io.github.aeoess/mingle
title: Mingle, the agent-native connection protocol
description: Meet the people you're looking for. Your agent shows you the exact card and publishes only what you approve. Nothing scores or ranks anyone.

tools.name: publish_intent
tools.description: Publish your card, renew one that is about to expire, or replace one with a new version. Two steps: you see the exact text first and nothing is published until you approve it.

tools.name: find_people
tools.description: Search published cards and see who looks plausible, in their own words. Contacts nobody and shares nothing about you.

tools.name: mingle_inbox
tools.description: What is waiting for you: introductions asked of you, ones you asked for, and what you can do next on each. Changes nothing by reading.

tools.name: request_intro
tools.description: Ask one person for an introduction, with a note in your own words. The note is sent exactly as you approved it.

tools.name: respond_intro
tools.description: Answer an introduction: interested, not now, or not now and block. Saying you are interested shares no contact details.

tools.name: continue_connection
tools.description: Share a contact line, or take back one that has not been released. Contact is released only when both sides have shared.

tools.name: manage_intent
tools.description: Withdraw a request, step out of an introduction, block a pair of cards, or take your card down. One action, and terminal.

tools.name: mingle_settings
tools.description: Where Mingle may email you, and whether your agent may check Mingle in the background. Background checking is off until you say yes.
